items.name: voice-input
items.title: Voice Input
items.description: A normal text input or textarea with a microphone in its corner: record with Voice Glow along the field, level meter, mic picker, transcript written into the same field, recap player, reset with confirm, and a send/don't-send-recordings line inside the field. Glow by Voice Glow (Jakub Antalik, MIT).
items.docs: Voice Input wraps a text field: use <VoiceInput /> as is (it renders the field) or wrap your own Input/Textarea. Wire onTranscribe to your server and honour sendRecording=false (transcribe, never store). Glow: Voice Glow by Jakub Antalik (https://libraries.dev/voice), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Jakub Antalik. Guide: https://github.com/Launch-Studio-Labs/launchstudio-labs/blob/main/skills/voice-input/SKILL.md
